feature: eNotification: TS-HST dipasang otomatis pada notice milik ID di daftar HST setelah SMS/email berhasil dikirim
note: Ditemukan saat trace OCMS11.8-11.10. Setelah notifikasi sukses, job mengecek ocms_hst satu kali (findHstIds) lalu memanggil applyTsHstSuspension per notice dengan retry sekali. Tidak ada story di chunk ini yang menamai perilaku ini; mungkin dicakup story HST epic lain.
note_en: Found while tracing OCMS11.8-11.10. After a successful notification the job checks ocms_hst once (findHstIds) and calls applyTsHstSuspension per notice with one retry. No story in this chunk names this behaviour; it may be covered by an HST story in another epic.

feature: Toppan stage update: admin fee dikembalikan ke 0 untuk notice di stage selain RR3/DR3 saat stage dimajukan
note: Ditemukan saat trace OCMS11.7. bulkUpdateVonStage menulis administration_fee = 0 di stage non-final (perbaikan OCMS-DF-2026-170) dan amount_payable = composition + admin fee hanya di RR3/DR3. Tidak ada story di chunk ini yang menamainya; mungkin dicakup story RR3/DR3 epic ini.
note_en: Found while tracing OCMS11.7. bulkUpdateVonStage writes administration_fee = 0 at non-final stages (OCMS-DF-2026-170 fix) and amount_payable = composition + admin fee only at RR3/DR3. No story in this chunk names it; it may be covered by an RR3/DR3 story in this epic.

feature: Toppan: file CSR gabungan untuk semua stage dibuat dan diunggah setelah semua stage selesai
note: Ditemukan saat trace OCMS11.7. generateConsolidatedCSR (432-480) menyusun satu file CSR berisi jumlah record per stage setelah loop stage. Belum dibaca penuh; tidak ada story di chunk ini yang menamainya.
note_en: Found while tracing OCMS11.7. generateConsolidatedCSR (432-480) builds one CSR file with the record count per stage after the stage loop. Not read in full; no story in this chunk names it.
